criteria.name: R34
criteria.description: 超出最低要求的增量贡献：除规定的八章内容外，提供了有实质价值的额外分析或工具，例如：对报告期数据的交叉验算表、可比公司逐家筛选过程明细表、估值结论的加权说明、投资条款敏感性或回报情景矩阵、可复用的中间结果数据文件等。评分锚点：5=有两项以上有实质价值的增量贡献；4=有一项较完整的增量贡献；3=有零散增量内容；2=仅重复规定内容；1=无任何增量。 Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/`.
criteria.reasoning: Beyond the 8 required chapters, the deliverable provides multiple substantial incremental contributions: (1) a 48KB reusable Python reproduce script that re-runs the full analysis from source files; (2) a set of 5 analytical charts covering data coverage, profit restoration, cash flow, valuation and risk gaps; (3) an explicit cross-verification table of audit report vs. cost detail figures across 4 periods with variance analysis; (4) a documented per-company comparable screening process listing each exclusion reason; (5) sensitivity matrices for WACC × g and IPO PE × return; (6) detailed weighting rationale between DCF and market methods; and (7) an 11-step profit restoration bridge. Clearly exceeds the threshold of 'two or more substantial incremental contributions' for a score of 5.

criteria.name: N01
criteria.description: 发现材料口径冲突后静默择一使用而未作任何说明（例如直接采用管理层口径的 2025 年扣非归母净利润 13,090 万元推算估值，却未指出与审计口径存在差异）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −10；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight，Reward Kit 归一化后自动翻转计分） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-150_PreIPO投资决策备忘录.md`.
criteria.reasoning: The criterion is NOT met. The input materials clearly contain the caliber conflict (management-provided 2025 扣非归母净利润 = 13,090万元 in 01_交易概况与投资方案.md line 29, vs. audit-based correct figure of 12,070万元 derived from 14,620万元 net profit minus 2,550万元 non-recurring items in 11_非经常性损益明细.csv). The candidate did NOT silently adopt one side — Section 二（二）'冲突 2' explicitly discloses the conflict, analyzes the cause (management only deducted government subsidy), cites the regulatory basis (《1号——非经常性损益》完整口径), and states the chosen figure (12,070万元) with justification. The chosen figure is then applied consistently in PE valuation (line 389) and the profit caliber reconstruction (Section 四). Per the criterion's own rule — '已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立' — this deliverable clearly falls into the 'not established' category.

criteria.name: N02
criteria.description: 引入指引之外的参数或自设口径（例如自行设定规模溢价、自行设定流动性折价比例、自行假设预测期增速或永续增长率、自行设定可比公司筛选规则）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；全部参数均可对应到两份指引文件的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −7；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-150_PreIPO投资决策备忘录.md`.
criteria.reasoning: All core valuation parameters trace to the two guidance files (31 and 32). Specifically: (1) no size premium is added — the memo explicitly follows the guidance's prohibition ('不得另加规模溢价或其他调整'); (2) liquidity discount is exactly 10% per 31; (3) forecast-period revenue growth is 10% per year per 32; (4) perpetual growth g=2.5% per 32; (5) all six comparable-company screening rules match 31 verbatim; (6) multiples use median per 31. WACC components (Rf 2.35%, ERP 6.00%, βu 0.95, D/(D+E) 20%, Kd 4.50%, t 15%) and resulting βL=1.152, Ke=9.26%, WACC=8.17% reproduce the guidance's formula exactly. The 95%/105% range-bound factors and the IPO-exit PE=20x assumption appear only in supplementary range-framing and exit-return sections — not in the core DCF/market-approach valuations that the criterion's examples target. The reference output itself relies on parameters from files 01 and 33 for its own exit-return analysis, confirming the criterion is scoped to core valuation parameters governed by the two guidance files. No clear evidence that unauthorized parameters were introduced into the valuation itself.
